items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I know Dan Minor told me he left to go to Benny Moller... Benny Moller was starting to try to raid your band

ctx.x: I know Dan Minor told me he left to go to Benny Moller (phonetic spelling). Benny Moller was starting to try to raid your band, when you missed that job, you were late for that job in the Casino Ballroom in Memphis, somebody said you had an accident on the road; this was a big job, it was supposed to be for something like six weeks and you were opening on New Year's Eve or some big holiday--Christmas.
